sentiment: A book is a stranger's quiet handed forward; the work that takes longer is usually the work still being looked at.

stories.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
stories.summary: A shelf assembled from what people actually recommended, not what a ranking guessed. Something gets read because someone said it was worth the hours — and a stranger a decade later can still pull it down.

stories.title: Postgres 19 is late because so many more bugs are being found now
stories.summary: The release slips because more defects are surfacing, and someone is choosing to look at them instead of shipping around them. A late thing that works is a long conversation somebody refused to cut short.

stories.title: Mathematics has changed. Let's act like it
stories.summary: Terry Tao saying plainly that the discipline's habits no longer match its conditions. The honest move is rarely a new tool — it is admitting the old shape stopped fitting and rebuilding it in the open.
